verdict.rationale: PayPal publishes a documented REST API surface (orders, invoices, subscriptions, disputes, agentic-commerce cart endpoints) with OAuth2 auth, a sandbox environment, webhooks, and pre-built AI agent tools/toolkit (create_order, create_refund, etc.), all discoverable via developer.paypal.com docs and confirmed live via probes. Missing for 10: independent third-party developer corroboration beyond PayPal's own docs/GitHub.
